[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Diviner's Ascent | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=110 }} [[Diviner's Ascent]] is the northeastern [[explorable area]] of the [[Crystal Desert]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 15 [[Cinder Linnwood]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Bleached Carapace]]s) *{{x}} 15 [[Luven Underwood]] ([[collector]] for 5 [[Minotaur Horn]]s) ===Charmable animals=== [[Animal]] *{{x}} 5 [[Dune Lizard]] ===Foes=== [[Devourer]]s *{{r}} 20 (26) [[Rockshot Devourer]] [[Drake]]s *{{e}} 21 (26) [[Sand Drake]] [[Hydra]]s *{{e}} 22 (26) [[Hydra (Crystal Desert)|Hydra]] (only 2 accompanying a boss) [[Scarab]]s *{{w}} 20 (26) [[Rock-Eater Scarab]] *{{n}} 20 (26) [[Jade Scarab]] [[Wurm]]s *{{w}} 22 (26) [[Sand Wurm]] ====Bosses==== [[Devourer]]s (spawns randomly) *{{r}} 24 (30) [[Flange Sullenrage]] [[Drake]]s *{{w}} 25 (30) [[Monaru Chippedfang]] *{{e}} 25 (30) [[Ghilaparu Stormstone]] [[Hydra]]s (only one will spawn) *{{w}} 26 (30) [[Graf Wask Derg]] *{{r}} 26 (30) [[Brol Migo Hinga]] *{{n}} 26 (30) [[Jewk Swem Pleg]] *{{me}} 26 (30) [[Chak Hack Schawack]] *{{e}} 26 (30) [[Sheg Zamn Mada]] [[Scarab]]s (only two will spawn) *{{mo}} 24 (30) [[Bleck Oogle]] *{{n}} 24 (30) [[Plunk Trudge]] *{{me}} 24 (30) [[Trech Schmoogle]] ==Interactive objects== *[[Bleached Bones]] *[[Teleporter Switch]] ==Notes== {{gw2w|Diviner's Passage}} *These quests will affect the spawns in this area: **[[The Monk's Path]] **[[The Mesmer's Path]] *This area accounts for approximately 1.4% of the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 135|low = 108|high = 166}} **There are hidden [[Sand Wurm]]s and [[devourer]]s scattered about the area. **There are also several groups of [[scarab]]s, but they are all concentrated near teleporters and between the tall obelisks. Avoid the teleporters and travel around the obelisk areas to reduce the number of foes to kill. **You do not have to kill burrowed Sand Wurms to vanquish the area, even if they have previously attacked you. **The [[Hydra]] boss group patrols a long route. The best place to wait for that group is in the small path that connects the upper and lower halves. **If having trouble finding the last foe, try checking the portal to Salt Flats, a lone Sand Drake can be located there. {{Explorable areas in the Crystal Desert}} [[de:Wahrsagerhöhe]]
